subject: Reranker selection, grounding metrics & pilot next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Reranker selection, grounding metrics & pilot next steps

Hi Asha — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call focused on model fit and RAG evaluation so we can get a pilot scoped this week. TL;DR: recommended model family, retrieval & reranker configuration for the pilot, links to prompt sets and benchmarks, and asks for a PO/timeline.

Call recap (high level)
- Goal: accurate, defensible answers for internal drug-data queries (safety summaries, study references) with low hallucination risk.
- Must-haves: per-response provenance, audit logs, and SLA for 95th percentile latency under 600ms for the QA flow.

Recommended pilot config (what we propose to run for 2 weeks)
- Retriever: dense embeddings (512-d) on chunked docs (2–3 paragraph chunks, ~500–700 tokens); chunk overlap 25% to preserve context. Embedding model: redwood-embed-002 (or text-embedding-ada-002 equivalent).
- Candidate pool: top 100 from vector store for re-ranking.
- Reranker options: cross-encoder (recommended) for final ranking to optimize grounding precision; fallback bi-encoder for higher throughput during spikes.
- Generation model candidates: redwood-ggml-7b-rlf (quantized 4-bit) for hosted dev; redwood-8k-instruct (fp16) if higher instruction-following fidelity required. We'll provide token-cost tradeoffs.

Grounding / quality metrics we should track
- Grounding Precision: % of assertions with exact doc-level provenance cited.
- Grounding Recall: fraction of relevant documents surfaced within top-k.
- Hallucination Rate: manual label on a random sample of answers (per 100 queries).
- Answer latency (server-side, p50/p95) and reranker latency broken out.

Deliverables & links
- Prompt sets and evaluation queries (short/long/edge): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-rag-eval-prompt-sets
- Baseline bench (we will run synthetic pass + your 200 QA pairs): I put a short baseline runner in the attached connor_postcall_notes.pdf.

Asks / next steps for Novabio
1) Confirm you can share the 200 QA pairs by EOD Tuesday (redacted if needed).
2) Confirm required SLA/retention language so we can scope dedicated capacity if needed.
3) Can we lock a pilot kickoff on Monday (6/1)? Marissa will send calendar invites.

I'll loop in Ben on technical latency/re-ranker specifics below. Thanks — Connor

Connor — thanks for the concise recap and the prompt set link. A few quick clarifications from our side:
- Reranker latency: our product owners are concerned about the added latency of a cross-encoder. Can you quantify expected p95 for the cross-encoder re-rank step for a 100-candidate pool?
- Data residency & retention: our security team requires 7-year retention for audit logs and a guarantee that documents used during the pilot will not be used to train public models.
- PO & timeline: we can get a PO in next week but need a pilot scope doc and cost estimate to attach.

Can Ben or Marissa provide the latency table and a short note re: retention/bring-your-own-key options? If this looks good, we can confirm the 200 QA pairs by Monday.

— Asha

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Reranker selection, grounding metrics & pilot next steps

Asha — quick technical notes, happy to run numbers against your infra profile. Short answers first, details below.

Latency (cross-encoder re-rank):
- For a quantized cross-encoder running on a single V100-class GPU, re-ranking 100 candidates is typically ~80–200ms depending on sequence length (mean candidate length 128 tokens -> ~120ms p95).
- If you need stricter p95 (<= 200ms) we recommend: candidate pool 100, use 8-bit quantized cross-encoder (fp16/INT8 path), and keep reranker input trimmed to salient spans (we can auto-extract).

Throughput tradeoffs / fallbacks:
- Use bi-encoder for steady-state high-throughput (p95 < 50ms) and trigger cross-encoder only for top-10 re-rank (hybrid mode) to balance accuracy & latency. Redwood runtime supports hybrid rerank routing and automatic cached cross-encoder scores for frequently-seen queries.

Grounding instrumentation suggestions (what we will ship in pilot):
- Provenance: attach doc id + character offsets to every cited assertion; surface a provenance confidence score.
- Grounding precision metric: automated check for direct exact-match citation where claim text overlaps >=70% with source snippet.
- Regression detection: daily binning of production prompts vs. baseline and alert on >=5% drop in grounding precision for a fixed prompt set.

Attachments: I've attached a small latency estimate workbook (reranker-latency-estimates.xlsx) with sample numbers for candidate sizes 20/50/100 and typical candidate lengths.

We support customer-managed KMS for key isolation and explicit "no training" contractual language for pilots. We can add a retention retention_policy=7y clause to the pilot contract if legal approves. Marissa — can you follow up on PO language + pilot cost?

Thanks,
Ben
